description_en: Amṛta Hiti, locally known as Pvaḥ Hiti, was constructed during the medieval period for the Poḍhe community residing in Imūkhel, Lalitpur.Thehitihas two water conduits, facing east. Generally, statues of Bhagīratha are installed under the water spout(s) of ahiti, however, this is not the case in Amṛta Hiti. A statue of Śrīdhara Viṣṇu is established on thehiti’s northern wall which S.Khanal(2068, 173) dates to the sixteenth and seventeenth century. The source of water for thishitioriginates from the hillock of Imūdvã. Due to rapid urbanization, the underground water level is depleting, hence thehitidries up during winter and flows only during the monsoon season.There is no evidence to appoint the initial construction of thehiti. However, it is probable that it was built sometime during the medieval period (Lalitpur Sub-Metropolitan City2007, 45). It was renovated by the local community in 1988 CE (VS 2045). The UN-Habitat and Integrated Urban Development Project assisted to form a local committee in 2008 CE (VS 2065) for the management of water collection from thehitiduring the night and distributing it to the public during the day. However, this plan did not work out.The local community cleans thehition the day of the Sithinakhaḥ, the sixth day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha.
description_ne: ललितपुरको इमूखेलमा बस्ने पोडे जातिका मानिसहरूको लागि अमृत हिति भनी छुट्टै ढुङ्गेधाराको निर्माण गरिएको छ । पोडेहरूको लागि बनाइएको हिति हुनाले अन्य समुदायका मानिसहरू यसलाई प्व: हिति भन्ने गर्छन् ।यस हितिमा पूर्वतिर फर्केका दुईवटा टुटीहरू बनाइएका छन् । सामान्यतया टुटीको मुनि भगीरथको मूर्ति राखिएको हुन्छ तर यहाँ दुबै टुटीको मुनि भगीरथ राखिएका छैनन् । हितिको उत्तरतिर भित्तामा श्रीधर विष्णुको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । यस मूर्तिलाई ईशाको १६/१७ औं शताब्दीको मानिएको छ (Khanal S.2068, 173) । आल्को हितिको उत्तरमा रहेको इमूद्वँ नाम गरेको थुम्कोलाई यस हितिको मुहान मानिन्छ । अहिले बढ्दो शहरीकरणले गर्दा जमीनमुनि पानीको सतह घट्दै गएकाले सुख्खा याममा धारा सुक्न थालेको छ, तर पनि वर्षा याममा पानी पर्न थालेपछि हितिबाट फेरि पानी झर्न थाल्दछ ।यो हितिको निर्माणबारे कुनै अभिलेख नपाइए पनि मध्यकालमा निर्माण गरिएको मानिन्छ (Lalitpur Sub-Metropolitan City2007, 45) । विसं २०४५ (सन् 1988) मा स्थानीयहरू मिलेर हितिको जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो । विसं २०६५ (सन् २००८) मा UN Habitat र एकीकृत सहरी विकास केन्द्र (Integrated Urban Development Project) को संयुक्त पहलमा अमृत हिति खानेपानी व्यवस्थापन समिति गठन गरी राति खेर जाने पानीलाई जम्मा गरी पाइपबाट स्थानीय स्तरमा वितरण गर्ने प्रणालीको योजना बनाइएपनि कार्यान्वयन हुन सकेन ।वर्षको एकपल्ट ज्येष्ठ शुक्ल ६ (सिथिनख:) को दिनमा टोलवासीहरू मिलेर हिति सफा गर्छन् ।

historical_events.event_description: The Lalitpur Municipality, in partnership with the Centre for Integrated Urban Development (CIUD), established this signboard. It is a part of the inventory ofhitiin Lalitpur.
The signboard, installed by the PURPP project and Lalitpur Municipality, mentions that thehitiwas installed for the under priviledged however is used by every member of the community.
Local people renovated thehitiby collecting donations.
